Outreach
We have an Outreach team for students with particularly complex backgrounds and fragmented educational experiences. These students require careful and considerate planning of the appropriate educational offer. Outreach develops relationships with our most vulnerable students to support them socially and academically so they can work towards being in the classroom again. Often, being out of a school or classroom situation for some considerable time, it takes our skilled practitioners to support these students to believe in themselves again and access an education that works for them.
The Outreach team builds bespoke study packages around a student's needs to support a blended approach to education. These packages are a mix of and not limited to:-
Face to face academic work at home or in the community.
Attendance at one of our many alternative provision partners.
Over time, students are gradually introduced into the school environment once they have built upon their skills and confidence.

About Us
KWS developed over the past 10 years was the vision of Karl Weaver and Sarah Nichols-Weaver to support children and young people who do not fit into the society model of education. Through their previous roles in Children's Social Care they recognised there was a need for a different approach to education in order to meet the needs of the most vulnerable in the area.
Along with a highly skilled staff team KWS offers not only an exceptional learning environment but a holistic, inventive and very current approach to engage these most hard to reach young people. The aim is to facilitate students to realise their full potential academically, emotionally and socially.
The learning environment is safe, engaging and conducive of excellent learning outcomes' as highlighted on the most recent Ofsted report 30 Sept-02 Oct 2014; we expect an Ofsted inspection imminently.

Charity
Future 4 Kidz
A charity built by young people for young people who, for many reasons, feel excluded from society. Many of these young people require additional support to learn to move into the world of work and make positive contributions to their communities.
Future 4 Kidz works with young people to adapt their lives to support their individual needs and allow them to break behaviours that are barriers to their success. Many of our young people have-
Future 4 Kidz provides practical routes for young people to achieve their aspirations, so they can succeed.
suffered abuse of various kinds
live in poverty
have behavioural and psychological disorders
suffered stress through neglect

Safeguarding & Wellbeing
The KWS Team specialises in SEMH for secondary-aged children. We endeavour to make a sustainable difference to the lives of young people. We believe that with a safe and nurturing environment comes positivity, the ability to thrive and the reward of contentment. The KWS team works strongly together, and with other agencies and the wider community. We are committed to knowing our staff, students and their families, and ensuring their physical and emotional safety. We offer daily support, to ensure that each and every person has the tools they need to be, or to become, the best version of themselves. Where further support, advice or guidance may be needed we refer in a timely manner to outside agencies and monitor and support the provision they deliver.
Safeguarding & Wellbeing

Welcome
Welcome to KWS School, Independent Special Schools, providing educational support across our two schools and the community.
KWS School empowers students with social, emotional, and mental health difficulties, including associated challenges. Many of the students that we support have additional special educational needs, such as autistic spectrum disorder (ASD), attention deficit and hyperactive disorders (ADHD), and speech, language, and communication difficulties.
Many of our students have not been successful in their previous education. Still, through the interventions provided by KWS, we build an education that supports the individual in growing and developing academically and personally. KWS students rebuild trust in adults and the community to learn and achieve their goals.
“Pupils come to the school having had a disrupted previous education experience. The school’s calm and positive ethos helps them settle. Students speak movingly about the difference this school has made.” Ofsted, 2022 & 2023.
